topic: New inventory manager facility attribute project
summary_markdown:
A new project is starting to enhance the inventory manager by allowing clients to add numerous additional attributes for facilities. This initiative will require significant work involving the Maps API.

*   **Scope:** The project involves adding new fields to facility entities, creating a new face entity, and modifying the database structure.
*   **Tasks:** Tasks have been created in Jira (DOOH-21, DOOH-22) for [p2] to handle map-related tasks. [p1] will continue assigning more tasks.
*   **Design/Access:** A Figma design link and write access to the GitHub repository were provided. Changes should be committed directly without requiring a pull request due to expected parallel development.
decisions: The project scope includes adding facility attributes, new face entity creation, and database structure changes.
action_items: [p2] is tasked with starting work on DOOH-21 and DOOH-22 (map tasks).
[p1] will continue adding tasks and clarifying functionality over the next few days.
A follow-up call will be scheduled after more time to explain full functionality.
